text: An aircraft carrier's runway is only about a hundred metres long. So it flings planes off with a catapult. Old carriers use steam. The newest, the USS Gerald Ford, uses electromagnets, like a giant rail gun for planes. In 2017, Donald Trump said the electric one needed "Albert Einstein" to run it, and told the Navy to "go back to steam". The awkward part: the electric catapult really did keep breaking down at first. The Navy kept it and fixed it anyway. Steam or electric, Dave was going in the water.
